adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the branch for destinations *without* `credentialId` iterates credentials by `type === destination.integration` and calls `createEvent(c, event)` without the third `externalId` arg. `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts:createEvent` then calls `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)` (no calendar externalId passed through), and `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:createEvent` selects `calendarId` via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, falling back to `"primary"` when no matching `credentialId` is present. Additionally, `CalendarManager.createEvent` returns `externalId` from its optional parameter, so omitting it means `EventManager` will persist `externalCalendarId: result.externalId` as `undefined` (see updates in `EventManager` mapping). This matches the finding: for destination calendars lacking `credentialId`, events may be created on the primary calendar and the reference won’t store the intended `externalCalendarId`.
